criteria.name: nonvacuous_instantiation
pass_evidence: explicit construction or named standard model

criteria.name: cohered_results_criterion_one_sharp_novel_weighty_result_package
pass_evidence: supporting theorems cohere around the flagship result rather than competing with it
narrative indivisibility test: each admitted theorem would lose force or become misleadingly motivated if detached from the flagship theorem arc
before-after novelty delta against closest literature
aligned title abstract introduction theorem order and conclusion
supporting lemmas serve the flagship narrative
the result package remains one recognizable before-after theorem arc rather than an accumulation of locally correct results
cohered results are treated as an admission criterion and not as retrospective narrative polish
final paper reads as a cohered result arc in which flagship theorem sharpness examples controlled extensions and nonclaim boundaries answer the same question
every new theorem or corollary declares its role as flagship calibration interface variant proof-system bridge or boundary and states the before-after understanding shift
fail_evidence: multiple theorem-like results can be removed or reordered without changing the paper main meaning
supporting results are advertised as independent payoffs rather than consequences calibrations or boundaries of the flagship theorem
no single before-after understanding shift explains why the result package matters
novelty is scattered across definitions examples and partial repairs rather than concentrated in a sharp result
ensemble of results where each component may be locally correct but the paper has no single flagship theorem carrying the narrative weight
fragmented ensemble of results whose components require separate motivations rather than serving one theorem arc
fragmented ensemble of results even when the individual components are technically correct
results can be narrated as separate mini-papers rather than as one cohered result package
locally correct results accumulate without cohering into one recognizable before-after theorem arc
the conclusion lists achievements but does not identify the one result that changed the problem

decision_rule.top_ready: C1-C9 and C11 pass; C10 passes or needs only minor revision
decision_rule.solid_preprint: C1, C3, C7, C8, C9 pass; C11 at least partial; at least one of C2, C4, C5, C6 remains partial
decision_rule.internal_only: any of C1, C3, C7, C8, C9 fails or C11 is missing or unclear
